title: Noether R147: compact P12-P14/R129-R130 rollup
scope: Compact no-patch coordination rollup for R144-R146: P14 survival bridge with R129/R130 feedback, P13 survival bridge, and P12 survival bridge.

local_package.packaging_note: Compact package keeps current cumulative, R144-R146 bridge docs/audits/source-route CSVs, R129/R130 intake feedback, and the running source-audit logbook. Deep nested source-quality JSON/image-info trees are pruned with a packaging note.

included_bridges: R144 P14 survival bridge and R129/R130 intake feedback
practical_instructions: Use this ZIP if the web session only receives one local Codex drop for the P12-P14 bridge cluster.
Do not use the R130 cumulative wholesale; it is useful source/header evidence but stale as a full base.
R129's P34 lambda/k correction was integrated in R141 and carried forward.
P12, P13, and P14 accepted spans survive the current line.
Keep source-quality caveats explicit: several accepted survival bridges rely on best-available 400/600 ppi sources rather than strict native 650+ page certification.
classification: No-patch compact coordination rollup and stale-queue-prevention evidence.
not_claimed: Not a fresh German TeX repair.
recommended_action: Prefer this compact rollup over separate R144/R145/R146 micro-uploads if only one handoff file is useful during a future Noether refresh/rebalance.
